assertions.assertion: States that EF migrations are required even if not using SAML
assertions.rationale: Explicitly reasons that migrations validate the whole schema and 'not using SAML doesn't exempt you', so migration is still required.

assertions.assertion: Shows the migration command: dotnet ef migrations add Update_DuendeIdentityServer_v8_0
assertions.rationale: Shows the correct dotnet ef migrations add ... -c <context> command; the migration name is user-chosen (UpgradeToDuende8) but the command pattern matches.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that v8 adds SAML-related tables to the schema
assertions.rationale: Only speculates that the schema 'very likely changed' and defers to the docs; it never identifies SAML-related tables as the addition.

assertions.assertion: Includes dotnet ef database update or equivalent to apply the migration
assertions.rationale: Includes dotnet ef database update -c <context> to apply the migration.
